text:
ben: Heads up - release promo blocked by CI pipeline 84321. deploy-scheduler shows long queue and artifact staging stuck. seeing uploader timeouts and multipart hangs.

deploy-bot: promotion_hold: pipeline 84321 auto-paused due to artifact-staging-lag (reason: s3-put-timeout). See /ops/releases. :warning:

ada: What's the plan? change window is 22:00 UTC today. we need to pick pin vs wait.

carla: infra dug in - eu-west-1 S3 edge returning 503 on multipart upload parts. the uploader is stuck at part 0/5. suspect regional edge degradation + our concurrent multipart throttle exposing it. logs: 

```
2026-02-10T19:03:11Z deploy-uploader: upload-part failed status=503 uploadId=3f2b... part=0 retries=2
aws s3api list-multipart-uploads --bucket rwd-artifacts --prefix pipeline/84321 -> shows uploadId 3f2b... (stuck)
```

carla: mitigations: abort the stuck multipart and reupload to eu-central-1, or rerun the pipeline with single-part fallback. ready command to abort: `aws s3api abort-multipart-upload --bucket rwd-artifacts --key pipeline/84321/obj --upload-id 3f2b...`

dave: QA flags: there's a flaky integration failing on the new image (analytics-worker timeout). manual-promote of the last-good image reduces immediate risk. rolling forward risks the flake hitting prod.

eva: confirmed flaky - e2e fails 6/6 on latest tag. last-good `release-20260209-556` is stable in staging.

ben: proposal: manual promote last-good, pin prod, then retry the failing pipeline async after we stabilize infra. carla - if you can abort now i'll trigger promote.

deploy-bot: promotion_attempt blocked: cache-metadata-mismatch between artifact registry and index; cannot auto-promote until checksums reconcile.

ada: decision: pin to `release-20260209-556` for the prod promote. open rollback PR for current image, add note to release notes: "manual pin due to artifact staging lag + flaky e2e". schedule retry 2 hours post-change-window.

carla: executing abort+fallback. aborting multipart upload and reuploading to eu-central-1 as fallback: `aws s3api abort-multipart-upload --bucket rwd-artifacts --key pipeline/84321/obj --upload-id 3f2b... && rwdctl uploader --region eu-central-1 --single-part upload ./artifact.tar.gz --dest pipeline/84321/obj`

dave: opening rollback PR and changelog entry. PR title: "rollback: pin prod to release-20260209-556 (staging artifact stall)". also notifying support for customer comms.

ben: after carla confirms checksum match we'll re-run the pipeline but disable auto-promote. manual promote only after QA signoff.

ada: change window set 2026-02-10T22:00Z->23:00Z. ops notify: @sales @support @growth.

eva: QA will run smoke + analytics-worker focused e2e once staging has the reuploaded artifact. ping when done.

carla: reupload complete to eu-central-1, checksum `sha256:b6e2...` matches expected.

deploy-bot: promotion_unblock_signal: artifact metadata reconciled for pipeline 84321. manual promotion still required by release leads.

ben: ack. Waiting for QA signoff then will run: `rwdctl promote --image gcr.io/redwood/release:release-20260209-556 --env prod --note "manual pin - artifact staging fallback"`

ada: action items: carla - file incident for S3 region degradation; dave - merge rollback PR and update release notes; ben - hold on promote until QA signoff; eva - confirm smoke results. reconvene 21:50 UTC to decide final promote. :thumbsup
